limits: Same generated general prompts, native backbone, seed, CFG and sampler across arms.
Calibration is restricted to the previously authorized general cohort; full-run calibration may differ.
Hybrid uses the exact run175 checkpoint with only8 structural teacher-initialization updates.
No training, partition/global adapter or owner run changes; full-frame initial generation.
Matched seed does not imply identical latent noise tensors when channel/grid geometry changes.
Initial appearance only; no claim about long-training recovery.

visual_review.native: Both prompts form coherent recognizable subjects and backgrounds.
visual_review.vae_only: Coarse woman/fox structures remain; finer facial/fur details fragment, green saturation increases and repeated grid texture is visible.
visual_review.combined: Both prompts become mostly pale blurred color fields; recognizable subjects are largely lost.
visual_review.interpretation: The exact eight-update run175 structural initialization does not preserve coarse appearance in these two initial generations. This is not evidence that longer full fine-tuning cannot recover it.
